causal_physical_evidence.rule: Derived booleans are allowed only after a verifier resolves and checks causal receipt references. Host summaries, peer self-report and operator affirmation cannot independently certify behavior.
receipts: Windows device-signed install receipt matched to exact manifest payload hash/sourceHead
Android device-signed install receipt matched to package version/signing/APK identity/sourceHead
distinct-device proof from two independent fresh challenges and distinct A3 device credentials
duplicate retry: first durable receipt + second same idempotencyKey/fingerprint + same prior result + zero second effect/Event
conflicting reuse: same key + different fingerprint -> conflict + zero mutation
real resume: transport-A disconnect + durable cursor/checkpoint + transport-B fresh binding + resume request/current-auth + recovered projection + no second membership
player delivery: host Event/outbox -> authorized projection batch/fingerprint -> Android signed applied-batch receipt -> host ACK
ACK-before-batch-loss: command receipt without batch does not advance client cursor; reconnect recovers missing batch
event-gap recovery: N then withheld N+1 then N+2 produces gap receipt and authoritative resume from N
stale authorization denial after canonical membership/permission transition with zero mutation
terminal invitation reuse denial with unchanged membership
actor-spoof denial against transport-bound canonical subject with zero mutation
hidden-publication proof from canonical hidden reference vs player projection/apply receipts without exposing hidden cardinality
causal_physical_evidence.privacy: Evidence obeys BRP-02/SMB-14 consent/redaction; raw invitation/resume secrets, private keys, SDP/ICE addresses, hidden payloads and cross-context private data are excluded.
